GET /api/learning/stream/source/:token.note: The purpose-keyed source token is the credential. A forged, tampered, expired or other route's token, and a token for an upload the item no longer plays or an item that plays no upload, get the same 404 an unknown path gets with no object opened; a session opens nothing.

GET /api/learning/webinars/:uid/calendar.note: The entry follows canSeeLearning: an open published webinar to any member, a program webinar to a member actively enrolled in a published program holding it (a removed enrolment is refused), a draft to the Super Admin only. Every refusal is the same 404 a missing webinar gets; no credentials or a disabled account get 401.
